title: 第二十一章银月在注视着你新书求推荐票求月票求收藏第二十二章王璃 我还是太弱了新书求推荐票求月票求收藏
slug: 这年头谁还不是个武者啊
content_zh:
第二十一章银月在注视着你【新书，求推荐票，求月票，求收藏】
眼睛睁开，望着熟悉的天花板，当王璃次恢复意识的时候，他已经在不知觉中回到了自己的房间。
王璃条件反射般一下子从自己的床上蹦下来，他不断在身上摸个不停仿佛是在确认什么，然后除了再次刷新自己是个天生丽质的“平平无奇”
这一点冷知识点外，并没有任何的收获。
而且他穿在身上的衣服已经还好好地穿在身上，既没有破损，也没有残碎，也没有其他损坏的地方。
这让王璃有些疑惑。
就之前真实，王璃可以肯定自己是真身进入到副本里的。
但现在又能在死亡以后，活蹦乱跳的浪回来，甚至连衣服都没变。
王璃摇了摇头。
他只能说，系统你牛！
至于系统在上个副本里，给自己的那個“福利”
，那位三国无双上将·邢道荣的种种记忆，乃至是武道经验，甚至是肉体上的本能记忆都能回忆的清清楚楚。
换句话说，王璃现在就可以看做是一个拥有“武者”
巅峰记忆的武徒。
再多给王同学五六七八年的时间，只要元气，还有各种武道丹药，药剂，物资跟得上，得到邢道荣所有记忆的王璃，弄不好还真有突破“武者”
的可能性呢！
嘿嘿嘿，真是可喜可贺，可喜可贺啊！
但很快王璃就放松了下来，一边自语，一边却又像个大马猴似的绕着床转个不停。
“系统！
发生什么事了！

发生什么事了！
发生什么事了！
我怎么就突然死了？”
事实上对于自己在副本世界的“死亡”
，王璃并没有任何意外，或者说这本就是他意料之中的事。
毕竟他可是在最后关头，为了将海皇波塞冬赐予海将军的【黄金枪（FlashingLancer）】的力量催动到极致，是将自己所有的寿命都当做薪柴，在小宇宙里燃烧殆尽的。
要是自己这样子都没事，
依旧能活蹦乱跳的从副本世界里跑出来。
王璃就真的很怀疑自家王爸，是不是有什么隐藏血统没有激发。
或者自家王母是不是真有给自己隐藏了什么绝世神器了。
要不然，这主物质世界里，是真的存在一位“雅典娜”
女神？
可自己小宇宙都燃烧成那样，穿着圣衣，连海皇的【黄金枪（FlashingLancer）】都用出来了。
可却死得这么平平淡淡，不明不白。
这……哪怕是崩碎银月的一角也是好的吧？
结果，就这？
这也太不给我王同学面子了吧！
王同学在副本世界里，最后的那一击的力量，按照他自己的推演，哪怕就算是一座恢宏山峦挡在前边，也足以将其直接崩解成一摊原子了！
可怎能就这样？
那我离开以后，副本世界里的银月怎么样了？

它又有了什么变化？
我这还什么都不知道就嗝屁了，那我岂不是白丝了？
王璃同学憋了一肚子的问题想知道，却找不到解决的路途，可不就着急的团团炸嘛。
但自己没办法知道，却不代表别人不知道。
“.系统？系统？我之后，那个副本世界怎么样了？你这边有记录吗？你倒是说话啊～”

Chapter 21 Silver Moon is watching you [New book, please recommend votes, monthly votes, and collection]
He opened his eyes and looked at the familiar ceiling. When Wang Lizi regained consciousness, he had returned to his room unconsciously.
Wang Li jumped out of his bed like a reflex. He kept touching his body as if to confirm something, and then refreshed himself again that he was a natural beauty "ordinary"
Apart from this trivial knowledge, there is no gain.
Moreover, the clothes he was wearing were still in good condition. They were not torn, torn, or otherwise damaged.
This made Wang Li a little confused.
Based on the previous reality, Wang Li can be sure that he entered the copy in his true form.
But now I can come back alive and kicking after death, even my clothes haven't changed.
Wang Li shook his head.
All he can say is, the system is awesome!
As for the "benefits" the system gave me in the previous copy
, all kinds of memories of the unparalleled general Xing Daorong of the Three Kingdoms, even martial arts experiences, and even physical instinctive memories can be recalled clearly.
In other words, Wang Li can now be regarded as a "warrior"
A warrior with peak memory.
Give Mr. Wang another five, six, seven or eight years. As long as he has energy and various martial arts elixirs, potions, and materials to keep up with, Wang Li, who has obtained all the memories of Xing Daorong, might really have a breakthrough as a "martial artist"
the possibility!
Hey hey hey, what a joy and congratulation, what a joy and congratulation!
But soon Wang Li relaxed and kept circling the bed like a giant monkey while talking to himself.
"System!
What happened!
What happened!
What happened!
Why did I die suddenly? "
In fact, regarding his own "death" in the copy world
, Wang Li did not have any surprises, or this was what he expected.
After all, at the last moment, in order to maximize the power of the [Flashing Lancer] given to General Hai by Poseidon, the King of the Sea, he used all his lifespan as firewood and burned it up in the small universe.
It would be okay if I were like this,
He can still run out of the dungeon world alive and kicking.
Wang Li really doubted whether his father, Wang, had some hidden bloodline that he had not inspired.
Or maybe my Queen Mother really hid some unique artifact for herself.
Otherwise, there really is an "Athena" in this material world.
Goddess?
But his own small universe was burning like that, he was wearing holy clothes, and he even used Poseidon's [Flashing Lancer].
But his death was so ordinary and unclear.
This...even a corner of the shattered silver moon is good, right?
Result, that's it?
This is too disrespectful to my classmate Wang!
According to his own deduction, the power of Mr. Wang's final blow in the dungeon world was enough to disintegrate it into a pile of atoms even if a majestic mountain stood in front of him!
But how could it be like this?
Then what happened to Silver Moon in the dungeon world after I left?
What changes has it had?
I burped without knowing anything, so wouldn’t I have white hair?
Classmate Wang Li had a lot of questions that he wanted to know, but he couldn't find a way to solve them, so he was just worried.
But just because you can't know it doesn't mean that others don't know it.
".System? System? What happened to the copy world after me? Do you have any records here? You can talk~"
